proposed_harness.name: audit_report_schema
proposed_harness.acceptance: Add schemas/artifact/audit_report.schema.json requiring schema_version v1, artifact_type audit_report, created_at, producer, status PASS|FAIL|PARTIAL, audit_scope, manifest_summary, phase_results, p14_boundary, findings, and summary. Findings must include id, severity low|medium|high, category, classification current|historical|dry_run_boundary|informational, blocking boolean, description, evidence, and optional phase_id/path fields. phase_results must include every automatic phase P00 through P13 with required_artifacts_checked, gate_result_checked, real_evidence_checked, blocking_findings, historical_findings, and status.

proposed_harness.name: committed_artifact_audit_cli
proposed_harness.acceptance: Add scripts/audit_committed_artifacts.py with --out and optional --root arguments. It must read codex/phase_manifest.json, artifacts/gates, artifacts/phases, schemas/artifact, and audit decisions as machine-readable inputs; produce the audit_report JSON; create parent directories for --out; print PASS/FAIL with the output path; and exit nonzero when blocking findings exist. It must not execute phase gates, run P14, probe live Valkey, or infer truth from Markdown reports.

proposed_harness.name: manifest_phase_coverage_audit
proposed_harness.acceptance: The audit CLI must iterate the manifest, include all automatic phases P00_REPO_CONTRACT through P13_SCALE_LADDER_50_100, and require each manifest-declared required artifact and gate_result.json to be checked. P13_SCALE_LADDER_50_100 must appear in phase_results even when its gate result has historical command or manifest-hash drift.

proposed_harness.name: artifact_metadata_and_schema_audit
proposed_harness.acceptance: For each manifest-declared required artifact, fail with a blocking finding when the artifact is missing, empty, invalid JSON/JSONL, has missing schema, fails its schema, or lacks required metadata keys producer, run_id, or status when the artifact type is a phase artifact. JSONL artifacts must be considered empty if they contain no nonblank records.

proposed_harness.name: gate_result_drift_classifier
proposed_harness.acceptance: Reuse scripts/codex_gate.py validation helpers where practical, but classify stale manifest_sha256 and known historical command mismatch separately from current blocking errors. P13's scale_tests command mismatch and stale manifest hash must be emitted as nonblocking historical findings when logs exist, checksums match, gate status is PASS, and required artifacts plus real evidence validate. Missing gate logs, checksum mismatch, missing required gates, non-PASS required gates, or real-evidence failures must remain blocking.

proposed_harness.name: real_valkey_evidence_boundary_audit
proposed_harness.acceptance: For automatic phases with real_valkey_required=true, validate every manifest-declared valkey_e2e_evidence artifact through schema checks and real evidence invariants: real_valkey true, probe_result PASS, valkey_version_prefix_required 9.1., observed versions beginning with 9.1. when present, nodes_observed at least the expected minimum implied by the evidence filename or gate command, data_path_result PASS when the gate command requires data path, and cleanup status PASS.

proposed_harness.name: p14_dry_run_boundary_audit
proposed_harness.acceptance: The audit report must include p14_boundary showing P14_SCALE_1000_OPTIN_DRYRUN is automatic=false, real_valkey_required=false, max_nodes=1000, opt_in_required=true, dry_run_only=true, real_evidence_count=0, status SKIPPED_WITH_REASON or NOT_RUN_OPT_IN, and reason that L01 did not run P14. Any P14 valkey_e2e_evidence artifact, real_valkey gate, automatic=true flag, or use of P14 dry-run artifacts as real coverage must be a blocking finding.

proposed_harness.name: committed_repo_audit_gate

implementation_plan.step: Define the audit report contract first.
implementation_plan.rationale: The report is the machine-readable product of L01; schema-first design prevents the CLI from producing loose summaries that hide missing metadata, P13 drift, or P14 dry-run boundaries.

implementation_plan.step: Implement the committed artifact audit CLI.
implementation_plan.rationale: The CLI should centralize manifest traversal, required artifact validation, gate result checks, historical mismatch classification, real evidence invariants, and P14 dry-run classification.

implementation_plan.step: Add deterministic unit tests with temporary repositories and fixture artifacts.
implementation_plan.rationale: Fixture tests make edge cases explicit without mutating committed historical artifacts or requiring live Valkey.

implementation_plan.step: Add the committed repository CI gate.
implementation_plan.rationale: The CI gate proves the current repository artifacts are auditable, P13 is included with a historical finding, and P14 is not counted as real evidence.

implementation_plan.step: Strengthen CI workflow coverage only if the new CI test requires it.
implementation_plan.rationale: A committed artifact hard gate should run in CI, but the change must only add audit coverage and must not weaken existing workflow commands or locked harness behavior.

implementation_plan.step: Run the L01 audit validation commands and schema validation.
implementation_plan.rationale: The generated audit_report is the persistent machine-readable evidence for this stage and must validate against the new schema.

acceptance_criteria: scripts/audit_committed_artifacts.py --out artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/audit_report.json exits 0 for the current committed repo only when blocking_findings_count is 0.
The generated audit_report validates against schemas/artifact/audit_report.schema.json using the repository schema validator.
audit_report.phase_results contains every automatic manifest phase from P00_REPO_CONTRACT through P13_SCALE_LADDER_50_100.
P13_SCALE_LADDER_50_100 is included in phase_results and records the stale manifest SHA and scale_tests command mismatch as historical nonblocking findings, not as a reason to skip P13.
P13 required artifacts are checked and the 50-node and 100-node valkey_e2e_evidence artifacts are classified as real Valkey evidence, with nodes_observed 50 and 100 and Valkey 9.1.x data.
P14_SCALE_1000_OPTIN_DRYRUN is represented only in p14_boundary as opt-in dry-run/not-run and contributes zero real Valkey evidence.

Fixture tests prove blocking failures for empty JSON, empty JSONL, missing schema, missing producer, missing run_id, missing status, invalid schema, missing required artifact, missing gate log, checksum mismatch, and invalid real evidence.
The audit CLI does not read Markdown reports as source of truth for PASS, run_id, status, real_valkey, node count, or coverage.
Existing tests/ci/test_postcheck_compatibility.py remains intact and is not weakened to make L01 pass.
No P14 gate is executed by L01 validation commands.
risks: Over-whitelisting historical mismatches could hide current gate drift. Mitigation: allow historical classification only for explicit stale manifest SHA and the known P13 scale_tests command mismatch when all logs, checksums, statuses, required artifacts, and real evidence pass.

A schema that permits arbitrary findings without required blocking/classification fields would let empty artifacts pass silently. Mitigation: make audit_report.schema.json require blocking booleans, classification, category, and evidence on every finding.

Treating P02 or P14 1000-node dry-run plans as real evidence would inflate coverage. Mitigation: audit real evidence only from valkey_e2e_evidence artifacts tied to manifest real_valkey gates and explicitly set P14 real_evidence_count to 0.

Using Markdown audit files as truth would violate artifact-first rules. Mitigation: use audit_decision.json only for structured audit decision checks and never parse AUDIT.md for pass/fail evidence in this L01 gate.

Updating historical gate artifacts to erase mismatch would lose audit trail. Mitigation: classify committed mismatch in audit_report and leave historical artifacts untouched unless a future phase explicitly refreshes them by rerunning gates.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not remove P13 from L01 audit scope.
Do not modify artifacts/gates/P13_SCALE_LADDER_50_100/gate_result.json to hide the historical mismatch.
Do not loosen codex/phase_manifest.json, schemas/artifact/*.schema.json, scripts/codex_gate.py, or tests/ci/test_postcheck_compatibility.py to make audit pass.
Do not run P14_SCALE_1000_OPTIN_DRYRUN or require VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN for L01.
Do not count P14 dry-run planner or resource artifacts as real Valkey evidence.
Do not use Markdown reports, rendered HTML, or narrative audit text as the source of truth for artifact status.
Do not mark missing metrics or missing artifacts as PASS; use MISSING or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON with explicit evidence and blocking status as appropriate.
Do not add network, Docker, or live Valkey execution to the committed artifact audit CLI.
notes: This is a harness design only. The worker should implement the L01 audit as a deterministic, artifact-first CLI plus schema and tests. P13 must be audited with its historical mismatch recorded, and P14 must remain an opt-in dry-run boundary with zero real evidence.
